function.name: find_typelib_key

parameters.description: The GUID of the type library to find.

parameters.name: wMaj
parameters.description: Pointer to a WORD to receive the major version number of the type library. If the initial value is 0xffff, the function will find the highest available major version number.

parameters.name: wMin
parameters.description: Pointer to a WORD to receive the minor version number of the type library. If the initial value is 0xffff, the function will find the highest available minor version number.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if a matching type library was found, FALSE otherwise.

parameters.name: wMaj

function.name: TLB_get_bstr

function.return_type: BSTR, which represents the string if it's not null, otherwise null.

function.name: TLB_str_memcmp
function.description: This function compares the first 'len' bytes of the memory areas 'left' and 'str'. If 'str' is NULL, the function returns 1.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory area to be compared.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: Pointer to the TLBString structure, the 'str' member of which is compared.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The number of bytes to be compared.

function.return_type: int, returns 1 if 'str' is NULL, otherwise returns the result of the comparison of the memory areas. The comparison result is a positive or negative integer depending on whether the 'left' memory area is greater or less than the 'str' memory area, or zero if they are equal.

function.return_type: Returns a pointer to a GUID. This represents the address of the guid field of the TLBGuid structure if it's not null, otherwise the address of GUID_NULL.
